categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Dahua Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a global leader in video-centric smart IoT solutions and operation services. Its main business segments include city-level smart governance, enterprise-level digital transformation, SMB (small and medium business) solutions, and operator services. The company also invests in innovative businesses such as machine vision and mobile robots, smart home products, thermal imaging, automotive electronics, smart security inspection, smart firefighting, and storage media.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages AIoT and intelligent IoT platforms integrating artificial intelligence, big data, IoT, cloud computing, and network communication technologies. Core technologies include multi-dimensional perception (video, audio, thermal, multi-spectral), AI large models (notably the Xinghan industry visual large model), multi-modal fusion, edge and cloud computing, and secure data lifecycle management. Production methods emphasize advanced manufacturing of video surveillance equipment, AI-enabled sensors, industrial-grade network devices, and software platforms with strong R&D in AI algorithms, machine vision, and intelligent computing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Dahua serves a broad range of customers including government entities for smart city and public safety applications, enterprises across manufacturing, energy, education, healthcare, finance, logistics, retail, and cultural tourism sectors, as well as SMBs requiring intelligent commercial products. Its operator business collaborates with telecom operators to provide integrated digital infrastructure and services. Overseas markets span over 180 countries, serving diverse industries such as urban governance, transportation, ecological protection, and education digitalization.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively in China with full provincial and major city coverage and has established 69 overseas subsidiaries and branches across Europe, the Americas, Asia-Pacific, Middle East, and Africa. Its products and services reach more than 180 countries and regions globally, supported by localized R&D centers in Hangzhou, Xi'an, Chengdu, Europe, and Latin America, and regional supply and service centers.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Dahua Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the smart IoT and video surveillance supply chain. It designs, manufactures, and sells hardware products such as cameras, sensors, network devices, and software solutions, while also providing system integration, operation services, and cloud-based SaaS offerings. The company maintains a global supply chain with manufacturing centers, regional hubs, and a multi-tier supplier network to ensure product delivery and service quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus centers on advancing AIoT and intelligent IoT platforms, emphasizing the development of 'Five All' capabilities: full perception, full connection, full computing, full intelligence, and full ecosystem. It invests heavily in R&D, particularly in AI large models, multi-modal fusion, edge-cloud collaboration, and network communication technologies. The company also prioritizes innovation in machine vision, smart home, thermal imaging, automotive electronics, and smart security inspection, aiming to accelerate AI industrialization and expand smart city and enterprise digital transformation solutions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of smart IoT hardware and software solutions, system integration services, and operation services including cloud-based SaaS offerings. The company also earns income from licensing AI algorithms and platforms, as well as from innovative business lines such as machine vision and automotive electronics. It maintains a balanced revenue mix across domestic and international markets, government and enterprise customers, and traditional and emerging business segments.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Zhejiang Dahua Technology is positioned as a global leader in the smart IoT and video surveillance industry, competing with other major players in security technology and intelligent infrastructure. Its competitive advantages stem from its comprehensive AIoT platform, extensive product portfolio, strong R&D capabilities, and global marketing and service network. The company continuously enhances its market position by expanding innovative business areas and deepening industry-specific solutions, maintaining a leading edge in technology and ecosystem development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 32.22 billion, representing a 5.41% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders surged by 216.73% to about RMB 7.36 billion. The company’s total assets reached RMB 52.88 billion, up 14.33% from the previous year, with net assets of RMB 34.72 billion, a 34.38% increase. R&D investment was RMB 3.97 billion, accounting for 12.31% of revenue, reflecting a steady growth trajectory and strong commitment to innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Dahua emphasizes delivering comprehensive, AI-driven smart IoT solutions centered on video perception, enabling full-scenario digital transformation for cities and enterprises. Its unique value lies in integrating multi-dimensional sensing, intelligent computing, and open ecosystem collaboration to provide highly adaptable, scalable, and secure products and services. The company’s proprietary AI large models and multi-modal fusion technologies significantly enhance perception accuracy and operational intelligence, differentiating its offerings in complex and fragmented market demands.
